explain.observed_auto: Seen in real AI work use: {share} of AI work conversations in {source}, and in {auto} of them AI does the whole task.
explain.observed_collab: Seen in real AI work use: {share} of AI work conversations in {source}. In {collab} of them people do the task together with AI.
explain.personal_use: This task shows up in AI usage data, but only {work} of that use is for work, so we rely on the research rating instead.
explain.earlier_use: Seen in AI work use in earlier releases of the Anthropic Economic Index since August 2025, though not in the latest one.
explain.penetration: Not seen in published AI work conversations, but Anthropic's labor market data shows AI reaching {penetration} of this task's work.
explain.estimate_e1: Not meaningfully seen in AI work use yet. Researchers rated it as a task a language model alone can do in half the time.
explain.estimate_e2: Not meaningfully seen in AI work use yet. Researchers rated it as a task AI can do in half the time once extra tools are built around it.
explain.estimate_e0: Not meaningfully seen in AI work use yet. Researchers rated it as a task a language model barely speeds up.
explain.estimate_mixed: Not meaningfully seen in AI work use yet. Researchers rated it {human} and GPT-4 rated it {gpt4}. The midpoint of the two ratings is high enough to count as sped up by AI.
explain.estimate_dwa: No direct rating for this task, so we estimated it from the rated work activities it belongs to.
explain.physical: Hands-on work done in person, not meaningfully seen in AI work use, and researchers see little help from a language model.
explain.no_data: No research rating and no published AI usage for this task yet.
explain.observed_api: Seen in real AI work use, mostly through the API: {share} of that traffic, and in {auto} of it AI does the whole task. Researchers also rate it as a task a language model can do on its own.
explain.seen_rarely: Shows up in AI work use, but rarely: below 0.01% of conversations, too little to count. The research rating decides instead.
explain.people: Work with people, such as care, teaching, supervising or negotiating, and not meaningfully seen in AI work use. Researchers did not both rate it as something a language model can do alone.
explain.estimate_low: Not meaningfully seen in AI work use yet. Researchers rated it {human} and GPT-4 rated it {gpt4}. The midpoint of the two ratings is too low to count as sped up by AI.
